items.reason: With zero interaction the page auto-polled getMetrics on a ~10 s cycle (log 1→2→3), data appearing and the 'Xs ago' freshness label resetting to 'now' after each successful poll; a failed poll surfaced the stale-data banner automatically.

Mid-refresh under slow latency I opened a service drawer ('media-worker' dialog), closed it with Escape, and toggled Pause; when the pending load resolved the UI was fully consistent — 6 cards, 'Outage' summary, refresh re-enabled, 'paused · now' label, no stuck spinner or leftover dialog.

Switching from 24h to 7d under slow latency immediately replaced the cards with 6 skeletons and 'updating' rather than presenting the old 24h data as 7d, and the 'now' updated-timestamp appeared only after the server responded; failed refreshes never advanced the freshness timestamp.
